releases.description: Vast 0.2.7 is the current official Windows release, with a rebuilt credential system, session-aware PDF handling, Electron 44.1.0, and production-grade direct and Microsoft Store release gates.

changelog.title: Everyday browsing and interface
items: Reworked the More Tabs control so it is vertically aligned, easier to scan, and exposes each hidden tab's state with a direct close action.
Redesigned the saved-logins fill menu and password-save prompt with Inter, calmer spacing, theme-aware Dark and Dim surfaces, and a smaller browser-native footprint.
Flattened and tightened the workspace icon and color picker, simplified Labs and Network Devices filters, and aligned mini-program headers with their actual product names.
Polished Session Timeline, Diagnostics, Network Devices, scan-log placement, panel scrolling, settings layout, dropdown positioning, and viewport-edge behavior.
Improved tab opening and pending-navigation ownership so new tabs, downloads, popups, and redirected navigations recover reliably instead of becoming blank or detached.
Changed clean-profile defaults: the opening animation and sound are off, bookmarks and New Tab quick links start empty, and the bookmarks bar is visible on all pages.
Preserved existing profiles and preferences through additive migrations; the clean defaults apply only to genuinely new profiles.

changelog.title: Password Manager v2
items: Replaced submit-equals-success capture with a stateful observed, edited, submission-intent, pending, success, failure, or unknown lifecycle.
Combined navigation, SPA history, form disappearance, validation, focus, field reappearance, and error-state evidence before offering Save or Update, reducing prompts after failed logins.
Added a reusable semantic field parser with token-aware autocomplete handling, confidence scoring, form association, labels, DOM position, and actual user interaction.
Excluded OTP, PIN, CVC/CVV, one-time-code, hidden honeypot, disabled, and read-only fields from account-password capture.
Added bounded, memory-only, origin/window/tab-scoped username-first correlation for multi-step email-then-password sign-ins and registrations.
Added signup and password-change resolution, matching confirmation checks, current-password account matching, deterministic username normalization, and duplicate-safe Save versus Update decisions.
Kept routine successful-login detection available when the management UI is locked while retaining fresh unlock requirements for reveal, copy, export, and other sensitive vault actions.
Made save decisions tab-scoped and non-blocking, retained Never for this site suppression, and avoided prompts or unnecessary rewrites for unchanged stored credentials.

changelog.title: PDFs, downloads, and local files
items: Rebuilt PDF loading around the originating webContents session so authenticated PDFs retain cookies, Referer, user agent, partition, and origin context.
Stopped avoidable second downloads by routing PDF responses through a scoped resource pipeline instead of navigating first and fetching again later.
Added MIME-aware PDF routing for signed and export URLs that do not end in .pdf, with validation when a PDF-looking URL returns HTML or an error.
Added bounded byte-range reads and a lower-memory viewer path, lazy thumbnail work, clearer render readiness, and actionable error/fallback behavior.
Moved Save/Download into a main-process operation with an observable result instead of a short-lived renderer Blob click.
Added Windows Open with > Vast registration for PDF files and support for dropping a local PDF directly onto the omnibar to open it in Vast PDF Viewer.
Restored download progress notifications and fixed browser navigation recovery after a download response.

changelog.title: Privacy, isolation, and platform security
items: Hardened guest ownership, origin binding, private-workspace rejection, secret lifetimes, and sensitive IPC policy for password capture and autofill.
Improved Spoofing Tools application and session policy while keeping each tool behind its own Labs switch and preserving Electron isolation guarantees.
Strengthened ad-blocking, tracking-parameter cleanup, external-window routing, popup ownership, and cross-tab navigation policy.
Added clear in-app Vast Services and Relay privacy disclosure with privacy, support, data controls, and local-first behavior kept consistent with the website.
Removed the unused Cat Addon implementation and assets from the source and distributed runtime, reducing unsupported code and package surface.
Rotated Extensions Hub signing infrastructure while retaining verification for existing packages and validating production catalog trust before release.

changelog.title: Runtime and compatibility
items: Updated to Electron 44.1.0 with Chromium 152.0.7977.65, Node 24.19.0, and V8 15.2.124.18-electron.0.
Included the Electron GPU-process fix for packaged AppX/MSIX SwiftShader fallback and added GPU-enabled launch-health checks that reject Application Error 1000 crashes.
Expanded Google sign-in, OAuth popup, permission, upload/download, PDF, restart, session-persistence, and browser-window routing coverage.
Improved controlled dropdown measurement and portal placement to prevent menus from escaping or jumping at viewport edges.
Kept the self-contained Video & Audio runtime, Playwright Chromium, bundled Python, FFmpeg capabilities, licenses, and corresponding source integrity-checked.

changelog.title: Windows and Microsoft Store readiness
items: Added a native x64 MSIX production pipeline using the reserved Vast Browser identity and corrected monotonic package version 1.2.8.0.
Separated direct and Microsoft Store distribution policy: direct builds retain the Vast updater, while Store builds rely on Microsoft Store updates.
Kept installed direct and Store builds on the same user-data location while portable builds remain isolated beside the executable.
Added installed-package launch, renderer, GPU, update, profile-preservation, and clean-uninstall validation with temporary CI-only package trust.
Hardened Default Apps registration and PDF Open With integration without writing generic HTTP/HTTPS class keys or Windows UserChoice state.
Made WACK parsing fail closed unless the complete final report explicitly passes, and tightened manifest, asset, identity, capability, and package inspection.

changelog.title: Direct release, updater, and verification
items: Promoted 0.2.7 as the stable direct release while retaining an explicit, isolated acknowledgement that these direct binaries are intentionally unsigned.
Added a real public 0.2.5-to-0.2.7 upgrade test covering the downloaded historical package, updater execution, runtime version, cookies, vault files, profile state, and Relay identity preservation.
Added clean install, launch, Default Apps registration, recursive PE inventory, silent uninstall, orphan cleanup, shortcut cleanup, and protected-registry preservation E2E.
Made Authenticode and SHA-256 checks independent of optional PowerShell modules/cmdlets and rejected blank, ambiguous, or stderr-tainted signature results.
Required production Relay D1 check-in cleanup, production Extensions Hub trust verification, full-history secret scanning, package budgets, fuses, provenance, and exact-source metadata.
Published installer, portable build, updater, full update ZIP, manifests, SHA-256/SHA-512 lists, FFmpeg provenance, and corresponding source, then re-downloaded and re-verified the public artifacts.

notes: This official direct release is intentionally unsigned. Windows will show Unknown publisher and SmartScreen may warn.
Verify the published SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksum before running the installer, portable build, or updater.

changelog.title: Interface and everyday use
items: Added the experimental Purist layout with a compact Topbar Island, functional tab strip, shared browser controls, and browser-owned overscroll space.
Made experimental layouts disappear when Experimental features is disabled and added a safe Horizontal fallback for stale Purist profiles.
Flattened the Dim theme with shallower shadows and more restrained depth, and increased the Vast logo size on New Tab.

Expanded Ctrl-K with direct controls for ad blocking, tracker blocking, tracking-parameter removal, third-party cookies, fingerprinting protection, HTTPS-only mode, forced dark mode, and spoofing tools.
Improved the Command Palette selection and focus outline, keyboard behavior, and settings-action feedback.
Updated Smart Unload surfaces for Dark, Dim, and Light themes and polished split view, window controls, navigation, hover/focus states, and narrow layouts.

changelog.title: Extensions and Extension Hub
items: Added an integrated Extensions page and lifecycle manager for Chrome-compatible, Vast-native, and hybrid extensions without regressing normal Chromium extension support.
Added profile-aware installation state, enable/disable handling, permissions, storage, content-script registration, background lifecycles, toolbar contributions, panels, and trusted package updates.
Connected Vast Explore to the live Extension Hub catalog with signed .vext package verification and a shared strict Chrome match-pattern parser.
Added IDU+ by Vast publishing and runtime integration for supported idu.edu.pl portals, with scoped permissions, duplicate-injection protection, persistence, and lifecycle cleanup.

Expanded the publisher platform with listing creation, package validation, review and release tooling, trusted-admin approval, versioned Publisher Terms, data-practice declarations, and abuse reporting.
Hardened Hub validation for Windows paths, archive traversal, case collisions, ZIP bombs, dynamic JavaScript, remote code, WebAssembly, and obfuscation requiring manual review.
Added canonical image processing, stronger edge security headers, auditable reports, legal policy pages, and GET-only download counting.

changelog.title: Privacy, security, and reliability
items: Updated the packaged runtime to Electron 43.4.1 with Chromium 150.0.7871.224, Node 24.18.1, and V8 15.0.245.28.
Hardened production packages with verified Electron Fuses, selective obfuscation evidence, stricter release metadata, and fail-closed capability checks.
Strengthened Labs IPC authorization, password-vault session locking, guest autofill isolation, extension trust boundaries, and packaged-app CSP.
Neutralized spreadsheet formula injection in exported password CSV fields and expanded Avidae SSRF, redirect, private-address, token-redaction, and child-process cleanup protections.
Added explicit Relay staging metadata and instance kinds so packaged, development, and test installations remain distinguishable and test cleanup cannot remove production records.
Added a passive signed Vast Notices configuration that remains disabled unless an HTTPS origin and pinned Ed25519 key are explicitly supplied.
Made the Cat Addon a central build capability; it is disabled and absent from the 0.2.5 public package, including its services, UI, assets, and filesystem probes.

changelog.title: Video & Audio and FFmpeg
items: Bundled the self-contained Video & Audio runtime with its required Python service and Playwright Chromium payload instead of silently downloading components on first use.
Replaced the previous FFmpeg binary dependency with a reproducible Vast FFmpeg 9.0.1 GPL build, pinned configuration, build provenance, capabilities manifest, and corresponding source archive.
Added functional FFmpeg and FFprobe verification for encoding, decoding, probing, filters, protocols, subtitles, metadata, thumbnails, and failure behavior.
Added runtime integrity checks, safer local-service startup and shutdown, and stricter packaged-resource and distribution-size verification.

changelog.title: Updater, packaging, and release quality
items: Normalized the public version to 0.2.5 with 0.1.5 recorded as the previous public release across package metadata, workflows, updater manifests, and artifact names.
Added a single-file updater and verified update ZIP that check SHA-256 before replacing runtime files while preserving the browser profile and Relay identity.
Added a real 0.1.5-to-0.2.5 isolated upgrade harness covering bookmarks, tabs, vault data, cookies, Chromium Local State, and Relay installation identity.
Added installer, portable, updater, update bundle, blockmap, exact-source manifests, SHA-256/SHA-512 lists, FFmpeg provenance, and corresponding source to the public release.

Expanded Windows CI and release gates for Electron versions and fuses, packaged resources, ASAR contents, extension E2E, app smoke, updater behavior, Avidae, Relay, secret scanning, and distribution budgets.
Removed tracked test captures, development baselines, obsolete release archives, and other non-product artifacts from the shipping source tree.

notes: This beta is intentionally unsigned. Windows will show Unknown publisher and SmartScreen may warn.
Verify the published SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksum before running the installer, portable build, or updater.

releases.description: Vast Beta 0.1.5 was an early public Windows test build and is retained for historical access.
notes: Early beta software may include unfinished features and unexpected issues.
This release is available as a Windows installer.
